title: Microsoft Copilot: memory personalises responses in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Workspaces
summary: Hold because the statement that the tenant switch is the only documented memory control overlooks Microsoft's documented ability for administrators to delete memory data. The roadmap facts and Graph update call are supported; smaller corrections concern licensing context, the eDiscovery search instructions and the control checklist.

claims.claim: The tenant switch is the only control Learn documents for memory itself.
claims.quote: Admins can use eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer to search, export, and delete users' memory data.
claims.fix: Replace 'The tenant switch is the only control Learn documents for memory itself' with 'Learn documents Enhanced personalization as the control for enabling or disabling Copilot memory.' The existing source also documents administrator deletion of memory data, so do not claim that no other memory controls are documented.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn ties Enhanced personalisation to Copilot memory but does not explicitly describe its reach in the named Office apps.
claims.quote:
Features controlled by enhanced personalization
Copilot memory - Memory and personalization make Copilot personalized to you and your work.
claims.fix: Replace 'Learn ties it to Copilot memory, not to Office-app memory' in the row note with 'Learn says Enhanced personalization controls Copilot memory; Office-app rollout details are not yet documented.' In the paragraph after the table replace the sentence questioning the control's coverage with 'Learn says Enhanced personalization controls Copilot memory; confirm the Office-app experience in a pilot.' This preserves the genuine rollout gap without implying a documented exclusion from the general control's reach.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout, eDiscovery search
claims.claim: Administrators can find and export memory data located in the CopilotMemory folder using eDiscovery.
claims.quote: For Copilot memory, you need to search the item class <IPM.Contact>.
claims.fix: Replace the checklist instruction with 'Run a Purview eDiscovery search for item class IPM.Contact for a test user, export the results, and locate memory data in the CopilotMemory folder.' The cited memory page identifies CopilotMemory as the folder in the export, not the search condition; IPM.Contact also includes the user's contacts.

claims.where: Governance guidance; Governance controls

claims.fix: The Before rollout eDiscovery and Customer Lockbox process check and the After rollout eDiscovery search have no corresponding controls-table row. Record this checklist/table gap; do not add rows as part of this correction.
